name: run_002
why: The full 180 second shot table of knowledge/DEMO-SCRIPT.md section 3, played in one take on the build: the title, the crawl, the drive, the walk to the quay checkpoint, the gate and its three replies, the dock office and the boarding pass, the TALK fight won by talking, the deck hound won by one FIGHT, the ship's log save, the defeat that opens the game over, CONTINUE on the game over card, and the cabin the save puts back. Card t_785b61f0, and card t_fb7e8271 makes the table the plan the recorder reads (data/demo/shot_table.json, table full). It is not run_001: that one is 71 s and is pinned as the walk take, and this one is the submission take.
beat_source: knowledge/mechanics/PACING-AND-CUTSCENES.md section 9 (the 32 beat sheet) and knowledge/DEMO-SCRIPT.md section 3 (S1 to S6, second by second)

game.env_note: No PP_ROUTE_HOLD and no PP_SLICE: this run follows data/slice.json as a player does. The crawl hands to the drive, the drive to the arrival, the arrival's map trigger to the gate, the gate to the office, the office to the boarding, and the boarding to the deck, where the map's sailor trigger starts the second fight and Percy's office scene starts the third.

clock.note: 180 s is 10,800 steps at 60 a second, the game's own step rate (spec 05, spec 07)

seeds.note: title_flash is PP_TITLE_FLASH_SEED, so the attract's lightning flashes on the same steps. The encounter stream is the encounter row's own seed (data/encounters/all.json: tutorial_sailors 20261019, deck_hound 20261022, percy 771), which the build pins by data and not by this file.

talk.note: The TALK fight's replies are baked rows in this build (data/meta_bake.json, the replay leg of spec 19) unless tools/ai_bridge.py is up on 127.0.0.1:8791 with a model key in the environment. The run records whichever leg it actually took and says which in the verify file.

record.note: 768x720 is 3x the 256x240 screen. min_seconds 243.5 is the bottom of the take band (253.5 s plus or minus 10 s, the width the old 170 to 190 s band had around 180 s) and the end step is 15,210, which is 253.5 s.

checks.note: palette_share_min is 0.55 and not run_001's 0.90: the quay and the battle field are drawn with roles the room palette set does not carry, and the measured fight frames sit at 0.39 to 0.40. The checks that catch a wrong take are the beats, the footsteps and the run's own failures.

down held 69 steps: nine tile rows, landing the feet in row 10 at py 154 (75 steps lands him in row 11 and the gate is never touched, which is what the 07:46 take did)

up held 5 steps: 10 px back to py 144, which puts the whole 10x6 feet box in row 9. The map lane moved morgan from (10,9) to (9,10) on 2026-10-30, straight in front of the checkpoint, and the shipped walk blocks on an actor (pp_world_blocked asks pp_overworld_actor_at for every tile the feet box touches), so a straight hold west stops on (10,10) with nothing underfoot: measured with tools/walker_bot.py, end px 158, footprint tile 10,10, and the confirm fires nothing at all. Row 9 is clear from the spawn column to column 8, which is why the walk goes round him instead of into him

left held 128 steps: sixteen tiles west along row 9 from the spawn column 24 (px 384, py 144) to px 128, passing one tile above morgan on (9,10) because his tile is not in the feet box's row, and touching no trigger on the way (row 9 carries none). quay_gate_checkpoint is a scene trigger and a scene trigger fires on confirm, never on the walk over it: 24 steps stopped on 21,10 after the map moved the start spawn west to 24,1, and the confirm there found no trigger underfoot and the route stalled on the field. The leg is 104 steps longer than the 2026-10-27 take, so the firing confirm lands at 44.73 s and not at 43.00 s, still inside S4's beat window (knowledge/DEMO-SCRIPT.md line 125, 0:39.03 to 1:19.03)

down held 8 steps: 16 px from py 144 to py 160, which puts the feet box in row 10 with its columns on 8, so the hero stands ON the checkpoint tile 8,10 and faces south: measured end px (128,160), tile (8,10), 26 footstep cues for the whole leg. The down is what makes the press a gate press: the reach box then covers 8,11 (empty) and the tile underfoot carries quay_gate_checkpoint

the feet are on the checkpoint tile and the hero faces south out of the gate, so the reach box covers 8,11 (no trigger) and the tile underfoot carries quay_gate_checkpoint; no actor's feet box touches the reach box, which matters because pp_overworld_step asks pp_overworld_actor_ahead before it asks any trigger.
